dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: A big bed and soft pillow, appropriate lighting, and even a miniature tree for embellishment...

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: One can certainly rest well in a room like this.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: I will try to finish all of my work before the sun comes up, and then... have a good sleep.
